title: xaerotracker F
description: A minecraft fabric plugin to make all players visible on xaero's map on client.
body:
This is a port of the original mod to Fabric, since I only play on Fabric myself. If you need support for another version, I might provide the necessary data or make it myself.

It allows you to see players on Xaero's Map as head icons.
thx cloud.
im testng omly on 1.21.4 and 26.1.2
